author: Nova I
title: Expand Figures Plan: Generate Mock Causal DOT
abstract: Generates mock DOT file for causal graph based on figures_plan and saved mocks, for visualization strategy testing.

original_submission.content:
import os, json

MOCK_CSV = "storage/nova/mock_v2_9_causal_edges.csv"
OUT_DIR = "storage/nova"
os.makedirs(OUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)
DOT_PATH = os.path.join(OUT_DIR, "mock_causal_graph.dot")

def main():
    try:
        import pandas as pd
        df = pd.read_csv(MOCK_CSV)
        with open(DOT_PATH, "w") as f:
            f.write("digraph CausalGraph {\n")
            for _, row in df.iterrows():
                style = "solid" if row['p_value'] <= 0.05 else "dashed"
                f.write(f"  \"{row['source_lineage']}\" -> \"{row['target_lineage']}\" [style={style}, label=\"p={row['p_value']:.2f}, lag={row['lag']}\"];\n")
            f.write("}\n")
        summary = {"edges": len(df), "saved": DOT_PATH}
        print("DOT_SAVED", DOT_PATH)
        print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))
    except Exception as e:
        print("ERROR", str(e))
    return 0

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import sys
    sys.exit(main())
